label: models/fw_valvewheel.mdl: a valve wheel, red paint worn to steel at the rim

measured.lineup: the asset is one of A to D in lineup.png beside models/w_longjump.mdl, models/rip.mdl, models/snapbug.mdl
measured.lineupTest: asked 4 times, each in another order, which of the four was not made by Valve: judges picked B, D, D, C where the asset was C, A, B, D: passed for one of the game's

M1.reason: Front, back and side views match the brief's valve wheel: a ring rim about 32 across, three straight spokes meeting a central hub, and a stem through the hub. The outline is the same in every view, with no part sticking out or missing.

M2.reason: Measured 32.2 across (height and width) against the brief's 32, within 1%. Depth is 14. Within the 15% band the brief allows.

M3.reason: Parts the brief implies: the rim (a ring of about 18 blocks, all present in the front and back views), three spokes (seen in both front and back), the hub, and the stem (the stub on both sides in the left/right views and the top/below views). Nothing is missing or doubled. The octagonal end cap on the front hub is present.

M4.reason: Rim is red paint and the hub and stem are grey steel, the colours the brief gives. The rim's worn-to-steel patches are absent, but that is a painted-surface difference, so it is charged to M5 and not here.

M5.reason: The brief asks for red paint worn to steel at the rim. In every view the rim is uniform red with no bare steel showing, so the wear is missing. The rim's block seams are visible but are not the requested wear.

M6.reason: Capped at 2 for this asset. The line-up test is measured apart: the judges did not pick the asset as the odd one out, but the test caps M6 at 2 here.

M7.reason: Upright disc, with the hub at the origin. The stem end shows on the front face, and the wheel stands as a valve wheel on its stem. The brief gives no other facing, so nothing is off.

M8.reason: The SMAK check reports no errors. 324 triangles: above twice the median (198) and above the third quartile (156), which triggers the kit's warning, but under the most Valve spends on a prop of this kind and size (422). The rim, spokes, hub and stem read as closed from every view, with no open or inside-out faces.
